title: Cup size and actual ice cream
hook: Two stated cases: explore the price per stated ounce.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the price per stated ounce affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines UnitCost, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the price per stated ounce in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy pack costs 2.26 for 7 units. What is its price per 1 units?
